documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: TPU for AMS
Bambu TPU for AMS Safety Data Sheet SDS20250723U02
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: TPU For AMS
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 11.2 ± 0.5 MPa, elongation 31%, impact 9.6 ± 0.3 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density and melting temperature are raw-material properties from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1190 ± 0.4 MPa, Z 600 ± 0.5 MPa), melt index 21.8 ± 0.3 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption rate 1.20% (25 °C, 55% RH), crystallization temperature N/A, spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), retraction length 0.8 - 1.4 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, max overhang angle ~ 70°, max bridging length 20 mm, support "Turn on", X1 Series heatbed drying 80 - 90 °C 12 h, the advice not to anneal TPU prints, odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, acid / alkali / organic solvent / oil and grease resistance, flammability and combustion products.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (registry type number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting, as in the other filament files. The TDS nozzle sizes (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm) are written to extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters, as in the TPU 95A HF and ASA files, and also kept as a compatible_with relation.
Elongation at break is kept as the text "> 650%" (data type number, no value_num): the TDS gives only a lower bound, and storing 650 would claim an equality the document does not make.

mechanical.hardness "Shore 68D" is stored unverified: it is stated only in prose (TDS p.1 Basic Info, and the store page Content Block-2), never in a property table with a test method. Unlike the other curated filaments it is therefore not listed as not_published. For review.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu TPU for AMS", model "U02-xx", composition TPU 65-80 % / additive 20-35 % by wt, CLP "Not classified.", conditions to avoid ("Avoid fire, elevated temperatures. direct sunlight.") and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI/IATA) transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values. The SDS prints its number as "SDS20250723U02"; the file name says "SDS20250723SU02".

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 220 - 240 °C vs material-table wiki 200 - 250 °C ±10 °C); bed temperature (TDS 30 - 35 °C vs material-table wiki generic TPU 30 - 45 °C with glue, 35 - 45 ℃ on Smooth PEI / Textured PEI); AMS compatibility (store page "All AMS Series Compatible" vs the material-table wiki's generic AMS row "TPU … Not Compatible"); AMS HT drying time (drying wiki 18 h vs material-table wiki 12 h, both 75 °C). The product's own TDS and store page are kept.

Marketing prose proves no number: "up to 60% faster print speeds compared to Bambu TPU 95A HF" (store page Content Block-4), "greatly minimizes the common stringing problems" and the Highlights ("Seamless AMS & AMS lite Integration", "Tough Yet Flexible", "Less TPU Stringing", "Blazing Fast TPU Printing") are not stored as values.

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for the glass transition temperature, the Vicat softening temperature, the heat deflection temperature (both 1.8 MPa and 0.45 MPa rows), and the bending strength and bending modulus; filament length is stated in none of the documents searched.
Hex: all 7 colours of the hex table match a store Colour value by name (White, Gray, Yellow, Neon Green, Red, Blue, Black); the table names colours without codes. Its title reads "TPU For AMS".
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.05 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 6); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/s5/default/b6cbfa38f55a4094ba59a66ff9577c07.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published. The FAQ's wiki guide on swapping filament onto the Bambu Reusable Spool (https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool) was not cached and not read. No /en/filament/<family> wiki page for TPU was cached.

The store FAQ (5.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade"; the same list also says it "contains highly hygroscopic wood fibers", which contradicts the TDS and SDS composition (thermoplastic polyurethane plus an additive) and reads as a copied sentence. No registry key holds either, and neither is stored.
The store offers the "Refill" Type value in Black (53101) only; the other six colours are "Filament with spool" only.

Adjudication against the second extraction (83 field disagreements in the current diff; every fact present in one file only or stated differently was re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, hex table, both wiki pages and the store page). Same fact written differently (62), this file's form kept: the TDS locators (17; "p.1, Section › Row", the hardness prose locator included), the hex locators (7; each row and column re-read in the hex table, every hex matching), the relation locators (5), material.type (the TDS p.3 Composition cell "Thermoplastic polyurethane", the document's own words, not the abbreviation "TPU", as in the TPU 95A HF and TPU 85A/90A files), and the nozzle relations (32 fields): this file's TDS Nozzle Size row (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm nozzles) plus one wiki row for the 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8 mm high flow nozzles state the same facts as the second's six per-column rows from the material-table wiki row "TPU for AMS", in the form the TPU 95A HF, PLA Basic and PETG HF files use. Present in one file only or stated differently (21), each kept as this file has it after checking the documents: material.spool_type stays the unverified store bullet "Comes with High Temperature Reusable Spool" (the TDS rows "Spool Material PC + ABS (Temperature resistance 90 °C)" and "Spool Size Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm" give the spool's material and size, not its type; both stay in that row's note); material.diameter_tolerance is not restated (the store bullet "Diameter: 1.75mm +/- 0.05mm" is written by the deterministic layer as its own verified store-page row; the TDS gives no tolerance); thermal.chamber_temp is not written (see the chamber note: no curated filament file writes it, and the second's 25 - 45 °C range does not fit the key's number type); the second's AMS lite row, taken from the highlight "Seamless AMS & AMS lite Integration", is already covered by the "All AMS Series" family row (compat-targets ams_series, whose members include ams-lite); the target handles bambu-textured-pei-plate, bambu-smooth-pei-plate and bambu-reusable-spool stay (each a manifest row; compat-targets maps "spool" to bambu-reusable-spool). Nothing was taken from the second, corrected, added or removed in this pass. An earlier pass had taken from the second extraction extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters (TDS Nozzle Size row), the high flow nozzle row (material-table wiki), Glue as recommended_with with target_kind "other", and the hardness text "Shore 68D", and had written material.net_weight in kg (1 kg; stored as 1000 g). Quote check: 13 TDS quotes (density, melting temperature, X-Y tensile strength, nozzle and bed temperature, printing speed, cooling fan, build plate type, nozzle size, and the nozzle, two plate and glue relations) are reported not_found only because the checker strips everything between a "<" and the next ">" as an HTML tag: in this TDS text that removes 2,714 characters, from "< 20% RH" (p.1, Printing and Storage Humidity) to the ">" of "> 650%" (p.2). Each of the 13 quotes occurs verbatim in the TDS text under the checker's own normalisation.
